The '''Flame of Dagnoth''' is a brazier deep within the heart of [[Grim Hollow]] in the [[Grim Reaches]]. It is an old, and almost ancient well of dwarven magic that was started long ago, as a tradition to honor the spirits of the dead. However, this once honorable flame has been twisted and corrupted, stirring the ancient spirits to wake once again.<ref>{{questlong|Horde|38|Return to Yor'thegg}}</ref>
